name: mustashrif
source: نافذة ٢٠٥٠ — ورقة تصميم الشخصية المرفقة من صاحب العمل

identity.en: A broad-shouldered seventy-year-old Arab man from present-day Saudi Arabia, an old wise scientist
identity.text: العالم مستشرف: رجل عربي سعودي حوالي ٧٠ سنة، عالم عجوز حكيم

face.en: Broad square jaw and heavy square chin, deep-set stern eye, heavy thick black eyebrows knitted in a frown, large straight nose, a thick black horseshoe mustache covering the upper lip, a black leather eye patch over his LEFT eye held by a thin black strap around the head, a long-healed stitched scar with small red cross-stitches running vertically on the upper left side of the bald crown, faint wrinkles around the eye, warm terracotta skin
face.text: فك عريض وذقن مربع، حواجب سوداء كثيفة معقودة، شنب أسود كث حدوة، رقعة سوداء على العين اليسرى بحزام رفيع، ندبة قديمة بغرز حمراء أعلى يسار الرأس

hair.en: Bald crown with thick bushy black hair tufts on both sides of the head above and behind the ears, and a thick black hair patch at the back of the head
hair.text: أصلع من فوق، شعر أسود كثيف على الجانبين وخلف الرأس

build.en: Stocky, broad-shouldered heavy muscular build, thick neck, upright confident posture
build.text: جسم عريض ممتلئ وعضلي، رقبة غليظة

top.en: a plain black crew-neck long-sleeve sweater, slightly loose, with ribbed cuffs and waistband
top.text: كنزة سوداء برقبة دائرية وأكمام طويلة

bottom.en: loose plain black trousers gathered at the ankles and black leather lace-up boots
bottom.text: بنطلون أسود واسع وبوت جلد أسود

details.en: the black leather eye patch over his left eye and its thin black strap crossing the bald head
black leather lace-up boots and the black trouser hems gathered above them

skin.en: Weathered seventy-year-old skin drawn simply: a few clean wrinkle lines at the eye corners and forehead, no pores, no age spots
